_draft_note: DRAFT — coach to author. This is a starter taxonomy of common club-level forehand deviations, written so the schema exists and the lesson-capture tool has something to pick from. The coach rewrites it; nothing here is authoritative. Rule: a deviation is a thing a coach SEES, named consistently, so lessons aggregate. See docs/TEACHING-PLAN.md, Step 3, decision 9.

deviations.name: Late preparation
deviations.description: Racket still in front when the ball bounces; take-back happens after the bounce.

deviations.name: Take-back too high / straight
deviations.description: Racket head lifts high and straight back rather than turning with the shoulders.

deviations.name: No shoulder turn
deviations.description: Hips and shoulders stay square to the net; the arm swings alone.

deviations.name: Contact behind the hip
deviations.description: Ball met level with or behind the front hip rather than in front.

deviations.name: Contact too close to the body
deviations.description: Elbow jammed; no room to extend through the ball.

deviations.name: Reaching for the ball
deviations.description: Contact far from the body with a straight, locked arm.

deviations.name: Contact above shoulder height
deviations.description: Ball taken late in its rise or on the drop, above comfortable strike zone.

deviations.name: Contact below knee height
deviations.description: Ball allowed to drop; player bends at the waist rather than the knees.

deviations.name: Weight on the back foot
deviations.description: No forward transfer; the body falls away from the ball at contact.

deviations.name: Weight through too early
deviations.description: Front foot lands and weight arrives before the racket does.

deviations.name: Arm-only swing
deviations.description: No leg drive or trunk rotation; power comes from the shoulder and elbow.

deviations.name: Wrist collapses at contact
deviations.description: Racket face changes angle through contact; ball sprays.

deviations.name: Racket face open
deviations.description: Face tilted upward at contact; ball floats long.

deviations.name: Racket face closed
deviations.description: Face tilted down at contact; ball into the net.

deviations.name: Short follow-through
deviations.description: Swing stops at or just after contact; no extension toward the target.

deviations.name: Follow-through wraps too early
deviations.description: Racket comes around the body before extending; ball pulled wide.

deviations.name: Flat-footed at contact
deviations.description: No split step; player is not loaded when the ball arrives.

deviations.name: Stance too narrow
deviations.description: Feet close together; no base to rotate from.

deviations.name: Rushed swing
deviations.description: Swing starts too late and is accelerated to catch up; contact is a snatch.

deviations.name: Head comes up early
deviations.description: Eyes leave the contact point before the ball is struck.
